request: I need an equipment inspection checklist: each inspection has a unit name and inspection date, with checklist lines for each check item and whether it passed.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Equipment inspection" with 2 fields:
  - Unit name (text, required)
  - Inspection date (date)
  It gets its own menu entry "Equipment inspection" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Equipment inspection records.
New line table "Checklist" on Equipment inspection:
  - Line number (whole number, required)
  - Check item (text, required)
  - Passed (yes or no)

Stored data: 2 new tables, 3 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
